requirement_understanding: The Jumbo Type module within Master Data manages classifications for jumbo roll types in manufacturing and supply chain inventory management. The flow supports full CRUD operations (Create, Read/Search, Update, Delete) along with reset filters and dialog cancellations.
requirement_gaps: Maximum character limit for Jumbo Type field is not explicitly defined in UI schema.
Lack of immediate duplicate entry error messaging before submission.
Soft-delete versus hard-delete persistence policy is underspecified.
business_rules: Jumbo Type name must be unique across the system.
Jumbo Type field must not be empty or whitespace-only on submission.
Deleting a Jumbo Type tied to active inventory transactions must be blocked by foreign key checks.
assumptions: User has administrative or Master Data management permissions.
Database environment is seeded with test records for listing and searching.
User is pre-authenticated before executing master data workflow.
risks: Accidental deletion of active Jumbo Type definitions could cascade to production records.
Unsanitized input in Jumbo Type name could expose application to XSS vulnerabilities.
Failure of unique constraint checking may cause duplicate master data records.

from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_jumbo_type_crud(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login')
    # Module navigation assuming pre-authenticated session
    page.click('button:has-text("Master Data")')
    page.click('a:has-text("Jumbo Type")')
    
    # Add Jumbo Type
    page.click('button:has-text("Add Jumbo Type")')
    page.fill('#jumboType', 'Auto Test Jumbo')
    page.click('button:has-text("Submit")')
    
    # Search
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Search by Jumbo Type"]', 'Auto Test')
    page.click('button:has-text("Reset")')
